runbooks.title: Add a machine
runbooks.summary: Put a host on the board without putting a key in git.

steps.title: Name the env vars
steps.text: Pick SSH_KEY_HOST and HEARTBEAT_TOKEN_HOST. Put the key and the token in the environment or in Actions secrets.

steps.title: Add the row
steps.text: In Settings, add the name, documentation-style host, and SSH user. Save the JSON and turn demo mode off.

steps.title: Install the reporter
steps.text: On the host, run reporter/heartbeat.mjs against a URL that is only reachable on your private network.

steps.title: Confirm the badge
steps.text: Wait for the status Action. Checks normal means a fresh observation. Unknown means nothing has reported.

runbooks.title: Rotate a token
runbooks.summary: Replace a read-only token without pasting it into the config.

steps.title: Create the replacement
steps.text: Create a fine-grained token with Actions read and contents read. Do not grant write.

steps.title: Store it as a secret
steps.text: Update the Actions secret named by tokenEnv. The config keeps the name only.

steps.title: Re-run the status workflow
steps.text: The next collector pass should show Pass. A 401 becomes Token rejected, not a green badge.

runbooks.title: Read a failed deploy
runbooks.summary: Decide whether the site is down or only the ship failed.

steps.title: Separate the two badges
steps.text: Website and Deploy are different observations. A failed workflow can sit next to a site that still answers.

steps.title: Ignore pull requests
steps.text: A red pull request run is not a failed release. The adapter skips those events.

steps.title: Open the run in the repo
steps.text: Use the repository you already listed. The dashboard does not copy logs into the page.

access.name: GitHub read token
access.holds: Actions and contents read for the repos listed here
access.where: Actions secret GITHUB_TOKEN or a fine-grained PAT in GITHUB_STATUS_TOKEN
access.note: The browser never sees this value. Public repos can be read without a token until the rate limit.

access.name: SSH keys
access.holds: One private key per machine, plus a pinned known_hosts file
access.note: The collector writes them to a temp file for the ssh process and deletes them. They are not stored in status JSON.

access.name: Heartbeat tokens
access.holds: One bearer token per host or agent
access.where: HEARTBEAT_TOKEN_* on the reporter and on the receiver
access.note: A token can only identify its own host. Put the receiver on a private network.
